title: Stationary distribution
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$ on a finite vertex type $V$, and let $p:V\to\mathbb{Q}$. The function $p$ is stationary if its distribution after one step of the walk equals $p$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph on V of natural-number degree D
p maps V to the rational numbers
